metadata.description: Agent skills I use daily and think are worth sharing.

plugins.name: think-brainstorm
plugins.description: Divergent brainstorming with isolated parallel sub-agents (v1; scored by a person on one question, counted against plain asking on two).

plugins.name: think-compare
plugins.description: Choose between known options: dimensions first, a winner per dimension, then one verdict with its conditions (v1; against plain asking on eight technology-selection questions, preferred in 11 of 16 blind judgments).

plugins.name: git-tidy
plugins.description: The /git-tidy command: clean up finished worktrees and branches with git tidy, deleting only what cannot lose work; recognises squash and rebase merges (v1; checked on 12 built scenarios). The git tidy command itself comes from install.sh.
